'''Engdo Taliav''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Sith Warrior]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who was present in the settlement of [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Engdo Taliav appears as a Sith warrior trainer in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
